package.description: The NetCoreDbg debugger implements GDB/MI and VSCode Debug Adapter Protocol in a unified framework, allowing the debugging of .NET apps under the .NET Core runtime as well as facilitating debugging from the command line (such as in GDB).

en-US.description: The NetCoreDbg debugger implements GDB/MI and VSCode Debug Adapter Protocol in a unified framework, allowing the debugging of .NET apps under the .NET Core runtime as well as facilitating debugging from the command line (such as in GDB).
en-US.name: NetCoreDbg
en-US.releaseNotes: This release adds Nullable inspection support, fixes several memory and concurrency bugs, improves evaluation and stack trace handling, includes code cleanup and build configuration updates, and adds support of native function breakpoints in interop mode.
